# USGS ShakeMap — 2015 Gorkha earthquake (event us20002926)

Downloaded 2026-11-02 by `code/04_shakemap_download_parse.py` from the USGS FDSN event API
(`https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?eventid=us20002926&format=geojson`).
Full URLs, product versions, timestamps and SHA-256 hashes: `shakemap_metadata.json`.

| File | Product | Version | Processed | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preferred_grid.xml` | USGS-preferred ShakeMap (source "atlas", ShakeMap v4 re-run) | 1 | 2020-06-03 | automatic |
| `neic_v9_grid.xml.zip` | Original NEIC ShakeMap (source "us") | 9 | 2015-07-02 | released |

Public-domain US Government data. Cite: U.S. Geological Survey, ShakeMap for the M7.8 Gorkha, Nepal earthquake of 25 April 2015 (event us20002926). Files are not edited.
